description: This file contains unit tests for the MenuDao class in the OrangeHRM project, testing methods related to enabling menu items, retrieving menu levels, and modules by name.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Tests\Core\Dao\MenuDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests methods of the MenuDao class related to menu item activation, retrieval of menu levels, and module information within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data and the MenuDao instance before each test.

methods.name: testEnableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Tests enabling module menu items and verifies the count of affected items.

methods.name: testEnableModuleMenuItemsByTitle
methods.description: Tests enabling module menu items by module name and menu item titles.

methods.name: testGetMenuLevel
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a menu item and verifies its properties and hierarchy level.

methods.name: testGetModuleByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of module information by name, including handling of invalid module names.
